God Almighty himself dwells in eternal fire. Flesh and blood cannot go there, for all corruption is devoured by the fire. Our God is a consuming fire. When our flesh is quickened by the Spirit, there will be no blood in the tabernacles. Some dwell in higher glory than others. Those who have done wrong always have that wrong gnawing them. Immortality dwells in everlasting burnings. . . . All men who are immortal dwell in everlasting burnings. God dwells in flaming flames, and he is a consuming fire. He will consume all that is unclean and unholy, and we could not abide his presence unless pure spirit is in us. All resurrected bodies dwell in flaming fire, for our God is a consuming fire.
